rationale: The audited target is an explicit, universally available unfolding of a named pointwise PDE predicate. D001 reduces to D002, whose two HasDerivAt witnesses are the time and space partial derivatives and whose residual is exactly qt + A qx = 0 in Fin m -> Real using standard matrix-vector multiplication. The theorem must not be misread as saying every q satisfies equation (1.1): it asserts only an Iff between the predicate and its definition, so both sides may be false for a nonsolution. This matches the source's role for (1.1) as the form defining the constant-coefficient linear system. Universal x and t binders provide the characterization at every point, while actual global solutionhood remains the universal closure of the pointwise predicate. The source gives no explicit m > 0 restriction; Lean's m = 0 case is a well-defined trivial extension and does not affect the intended positive-dimensional statement. No unresolved dependency or semantic mismatch remains, so both implication directions hold and adjudication is unnecessary.
